out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Shellstock Label Marked, Last Date Served/Sold Info
violations.observation: The date when the last shellstock from the container is sold or served is not recorded on the tag or label. OBSERVED TWO SHELLSTOCK TAGS WITHOUT DATE MARKINGS FOR WHEN THE LAST PIECE WAS SOLD.
violations.corrective_action: The identity of the source of shellstock (oysters, clams, mussels) that are sold or served shall be maintained by retaining shellstock tags or labels and marking the tag or label with the date when the last shellstock from the container is sold or served. MUSSELS ARE A NEW MENU ITEM. PIC ADDED DATE TO TAGS DURING INSPECTION. EHS REVIEWED SHELLSTOCK REQUIREMENTS WITH THE PIC. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed no paper towels at the hand sink by the 3 compartment sink/dish machine
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC PLACED PAPER TOWELS AT THIS SINK. INSTALL A PAPER TOWEL DISPENSER NEXT TO THIS HAND SINK.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The large dish machine in the kitchen was observed at 0ppm of chlorine. Kitchen equipment and other food storage containers were observed being washed but not sanitized in the dish machine
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. PIC SET UP THE 3 COMPARTMENT SINK TO MANUALLY SANITIZE. PIC INSTRUCTED STAFF TO SANITIZE ALL DISHES IN THE 3 COMPARTMENT SINK.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Other Chemical Proper Use
violations.observation: The operator is using a sanitizer, EcoLab Sink and Surface Sanitizer containing Lactic Acid, that is not chlorine, iodine, or quaternary ammonium compound. Observed sanitizer buckets with sanitizer solution not at the prescribed lactic acid concentration of 704-1875ppm.
violations.corrective_action: If a chemical sanitizer other than chlorine, iodine, or quaternary ammonium compound is used it shall be applied in accordance with the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling. PIC REPLACED THE SANITIZER SOLUTION AND INSTRUCTED ALL STAFF TO REMAKE THEIR SANITIZER BUCKETS. OBSERVED CORRECTED SANITIZER CONCENTRATION BETWEEN 704-1875ppm USING PIC’S SANITIZER TEST STRIPS.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: Time as a Public Health Control, Written Procedures
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide written procedures for the use of time as a public health control with the following time/temperature control for safety food item(s): 1) garlic butter; 2) au jus glaze
violations.corrective_action: If time only is used as a public health control for a working supply of time/temperature control for safety food before cooking or for ready to eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that is displayed or held for service for immediate consumption, written procedures shall be prepared in advance and maintained in the food establishment and made available to the regulatory authority upon request. PIC LABELED THE TPHC FOODS WITH THE TIME IT WAS SET OUT AND THE TIME IT IS TO BE DISCARDED (4 HOURS LATER). ENSURE TO LABEL THE TPHC FOOD EVERY TIME IT IS SET OUT ON THE LINE.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed no paper towels at the handsink by the dish machine
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC PLACED PAPER TOWELS BY THIS HANDSINK.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: large dish machine in the kitchen was observed less than 50ppm
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. PIC CALLED SERVICE TECHNICIAN TO REPAIR MACHINE. PIC INSTRUCTED STAFF TO RE-SANITIZE KITCHEN UTENSILS AND DISHES IN THE 3 COMPARTMENT SINK IN THE TIME BEING. SERVICE TECHNICIAN REPAIRED DISH MACHINE. DISH MACHINE WAS LATER OBSERVED SANITIZING AT 50ppm.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Quaternary Ammonium Requirements
violations.observation: Observed multiple sanitizer buckets on the cookline with less than 200ppm of quaternary ammonium.
violations.corrective_action: The quaternary ammonium sanitizer used in this facility shall have a minimum concentration of at least 200 ppm OR a concentration between 150-400ppm based on the manufacturer's use directions and using the appropriate test kit. PIC REFILLED THE SANITIZER BUCKETS. WHEN RETESTED, BUCKETS WERE OBSERVED SANITIZING.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) tomato sauce in a countertop steam well was observed between 117f-127f
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC REHEATED THE TOMATO SAUCE IN A POT ON THE STOVE TO 165f. TOMATO SAUCE WAS PUT BACK INTO THE STEAM WELL.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: Time as a Public Health Control, Written Procedures
violations.observation: The person in charge is not able to provide written procedures for the use of time as a public health control with the following time/temperature control for safety food item(s): 1) garlic butter at the the pizza station was observed at 57f at ambient temperature.
violations.corrective_action: If time only is used as a public health control for a working supply of time/temperature control for safety food before cooking or for ready to eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that is displayed or held for service for immediate consumption, written procedures shall be prepared in advance and maintained in the food establishment and made available to the regulatory authority upon request. CHEF LABELED THE GARLIC BUTTER WITH THE TIME IT WAS PUT OUT AND THE TIME IT IS TO BE DISCARDED 4 HOURS LATER. EHS PROVIDED PIC WITH A TPHC DOCUMENT INDICATING GARLIC BUTTER WILL BE HELD AT AMBIENT TEMPERATURE AND IS TO BE DISCARDED EVERY 4 HOURS.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: In the top portion of the 9 DWR prep top cooler (pantry station); couscous (50f), cut tomatoes (51f), sausage and pancetta (50f), unsalted butter (52f). Upon discussion with PIC, the service line was refilled 30mins to 1hr ago. In the 2DWR prep top (charcuterie); fava beans (53f)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC MOVED ALL THE AFOREMENTIONED FOOD ITEMS TO THE WALK IN. PIC DISCARDED THE FAVA BEANS.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: 1) 9DWR prep top cooler (pantry); 2) 9DWR prep top cooler (grill); 3) 6DWR prep top cooler (pizza); 4) 2DR prep top cooler (charcuterie)
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC TO PLACE A THERMOMETER IN EVERY COOLER.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Miscellaneous Source Contamination
violations.observation: Dark discoloration inside the ice machine was observed.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination that may result from a factor or source not specified under Subparts 3-301 through 3-306. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO CLEAN THE ICE MACHINE.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 1) the top portion of the 9DWR prep top cooler (pantry)
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC TO ENSURE THE ICE IS TOUCHING THE BOTTOM OF THE METAL PANS. AVOID DOUBLE OR TRIPLE STACKING PANS, AND COVER DURING SLOWER TIMES TO ENSURE THE FOOD REMAINS AT 41f OR COOLER. North Italia (Inspection Date: 06/02/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the dish washing area being used to store a cleaning rag.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. PIC disposed of the cleaning rag
